svg.aria-label: MatchPoint. Problem: invoice mismatches are fixed by hand. Constraint: post only inside the approval limit, never twice, and prove it. Decision: check rules first, post once, read it back. Result: 60% fewer exceptions in simulated runs, about 12 thousand down to 4.8 thousand; the rest go to a person.
